description: Automatic BAL uses current occupancy and resynchronizes restrictively without train movement.
given: Three explicitly chained signals use a configurable bal-3 profile and extended-accessory mapping.
The final signal declares a stop terminal; detector sources are initially unknown.
HTTP and WebSocket report commanded aspects separately from qualified observations.
when: Fresh detector snapshots report all three blocks free.
Network or track power is interrupted, then restored with the train moved while disconnected.
Only the first R-BUS group replies, then the remaining group replies without a new physical change.
An existing WebSocket requests a snapshot and a second client reconnects.
then: Each synchronization generation sends its configured stop before any opening.
Unknown protection remains at stop; a free block with unknown downstream permits caution only.
REST and both WebSocket clients recover the current aspects and occupied block.
Station echoes never become physical confirmation; prior openings are not replayed.
